name: Sunitinib (single agent)

biomarkers.note: Clear cell RCC (subtypes #55/#56). Sunitinib is a multitargeted VEGFR/PDGFR/KIT oral TKI; no companion biomarker is required to start. Listed as a first-line systemic option for relapsed or stage IV clear cell RCC per Standard Guidelines (NCCN), Kidney Cancer v1.2027 (regimen named on the systemic-therapy pages; mg dosing is not printed in the guideline).

lineOfTherapy: first-line for advanced or metastatic clear cell RCC (all risk groups); also used in subsequent lines

eligibilityCriteria.locator: v1.2027, first-line systemic therapy for relapse or stage IV clear cell RCC (Sunitinib listed as a first-line option, systemic-therapy pages)

drugs.name: Sunitinib

provenance.source: DeVita, Hellman, and Rosenberg's Cancer: Principles & Practice of Oncology, 12th ed.
provenance.locator: line 77734 (oral sunitinib 50 mg daily for 4 weeks with 2 weeks off / 6-week cycles)

drugs.notes: Source: DeVita 12th ed., line 77734: sunitinib 50 mg PO daily for 4 weeks on, then 2 weeks off (6-week / 42-day cycle). This is the canonical sunitinib schedule; the same 50 mg 4/2 schedule is the standard used in metastatic clear cell RCC. Represented as days 1 to 28 (4 weeks on) of a 42-day cycle (2 weeks off). Standard Guidelines (NCCN) Kidney Cancer v1.2027 names sunitinib as a first-line RCC regimen but does not print the mg dose.

supportiveCare: Blood pressure monitoring and management (VEGF TKI hypertension).
Monitor for hand-foot skin reaction, mucositis, and fatigue; dermatologic supportive care as needed.
Baseline and periodic thyroid function (TSH) - TKI-induced hypothyroidism.
CBC and liver function before and during treatment.

doseModificationRules.condition: grade 3 hypertension or symptomatic HFSR or transaminase elevation
doseModificationRules.text: Hold and resume at a reduced dose per labeling for grade 3 or higher hypertension, hand-foot skin reaction, or hepatotoxicity; obtain clinical review.

core.source: DeVita, Hellman, and Rosenberg's Cancer: Principles & Practice of Oncology, 12th ed.
core.locator: line 77734 (sunitinib 50 mg daily for 4 weeks with 2 weeks off / 6-week cycles)

guideline.locator: First-line systemic therapy for relapse or stage IV clear cell RCC (Sunitinib listed as a first-line regimen; systemic-therapy pages, lines ~1047-1105). mg dosing not printed in the guideline.

provenanceNote: ONCQIS Standard Protocol draft for single-agent sunitinib in advanced clear cell renal cell carcinoma (serves clear cell subtypes #55 and #56). The dose (sunitinib 50 mg PO daily, 4 weeks on / 2 weeks off, 42-day cycle) is sourced to DeVita 12th ed., line 77734, which states the canonical sunitinib 50 mg 4/2 schedule; it is the same schedule used in metastatic clear cell RCC. Standard Guidelines (NCCN), Kidney Cancer v1.2027 names sunitinib as a first-line clear cell RCC regimen but does not print a mg dose, so the numeric dose is grounded to DeVita. VEGF TKI class monitoring (blood pressure, hand-foot skin reaction, liver function, thyroid) is included. No field is set to VERIFY. This remains a StewardMD Standard Protocol; no endorsement implied.
